description: This Java class defines a model object representing a mapping between two Concept Reference Terms in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes fields for the mapping ID, the two terms being mapped, constructors, getter/setter methods, and overrides for equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermMap
classes.description: Represents a mapping between two Concept Reference Terms within OpenMRS, including fields for ID, the terms, and related constructors and methods.

methods.name: getConceptReferenceTermMapId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this concept reference term map.

methods.name: setConceptReferenceTermMapId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this concept reference term map.

methods.name: getTermA
methods.description: Returns the first ConceptReferenceTerm involved in the mapping.

methods.name: setTermA
methods.description: Sets the first ConceptReferenceTerm involved in the mapping.

methods.name: getTermB
methods.description: Returns the second ConceptReferenceTerm involved in the mapping.

methods.name: setTermB
methods.description: Sets the second ConceptReferenceTerm involved in the mapping.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements OpenmrsObject#getId(), returns the map's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements OpenmrsObject#setId(), assigns the map's ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the conceptReferenceTermMapId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the conceptReferenceTermMapId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the map's ID.
